title: Auditing and Decomposing Feedback-Driven Evolution in LLM Test Generation under the Oracle Problem
abstract: arXiv:2608.19626v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Execution feedback is often treated as a self-verifying signal for improving LLM-generated tests. However, when generated inputs are executed on a single accepted program and its outputs are used as ground truth, invalid or underspecified inputs can create spurious fault detections and apparent evolutionary gains. We audit this failure mode in feedback-driven test generation using 142 development tasks, 114 locked external tasks, and 138 held-out tasks, with two code models, three seeds, and fault-cross-fitted real submissions. On external inputs for which three accepted implementations agree, generated outputs match the panel on only 27.79% and 50.12% of cases. A single-reference oracle inflates the measured gain from evolution by 9.46-14.85 percentage points; after auditing, equal-budget independent resampling outperforms mutation-based evolution by 6.01-18.83 points. translated_title: 在预言机问题下审计与分解LLM测试生成中的反馈驱动演化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19626v1 公告类型：新 摘要：执行反馈常被视为改进LLM生成测试的自我验证信号。然而，当生成的输入在单个被接受的程序上执行且其输出被用作基准真值时，无效或欠规范的输入可能产生虚假的故障检测和表面上的演化增益。我们使用142个开发任务、114个锁定外部任务和138个保留任务，结合两个代码模型、三个随机种子和故障交叉拟合的真实提交，审计了反馈驱动测试生成中的这一失败模式。在三个被接受的实现一致的外部输入上，生成输出仅与专家组在27.79%和50.12%的案例中匹配。单一参考预言机将演化测量的增益膨胀了9.46-14.85个百分点；审计后，等预算独立重采样比基于突变的演化高出6.01-18.83个百分点。我们进一步比较了真实的三轮反馈循环与密度化方法。
tldr: 本文发现单一参考预言机在LLM测试生成中会导致虚假的演化增益，并提出了审计方法及更可靠的独立重采样策略。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that single-reference oracles cause spurious evolutionary gains in LLM test generation, and proposes auditing methods with more reliable independent resampling strategies.
